    What the model looks at

    These are the model's inputs: the clock, and how often trips crawled in May from this zone, to that zone, on this route and at this time of day. It knows nothing about today's traffic, weather or events.

    Team C · Project 1. Model: logistic regression trained on May 2026 only ( trips), warning at 26% or more, the cheapest threshold on June when a missed crawl costs 3 and a needless warning costs 1. July PR AUC 0.610. Crawl rates on the Explore map are observed pickups, not predictions.
